before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: Hello. What are you doing here?

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: Duffy's the name. I'm a natural historian from Varrock Museum. My team and I are here to explore this mountain.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: It's just an old mountain isn't it? What natural history are you hoping to find here?

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: Bahaha, you adventurers are all the same, never seeing past the fights and treasure...
This Mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
Indeed, they're a fascinating species! We're hoping to learn about their origins and how they've evolved.
However, we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Kourend Grand Library to aid us in our research.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: What have you learned so far?

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: Well, we have a theory that lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
Right now we're looking for evidence to prove this theory, but's it's proving somewhat difficult.
No thanks adventurer, natural history studies are delicate and precise... but if we ever need something haphazardly destroyed we'll let you know.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.player: Not all adventurers only care about fighting, you know... I was only offering to help.

before-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteo.npc: We don't need your help. Run along now, go and play in the dungeons with the other adventurers. I hear they're full of monsters to fight!
Try not to get yourself killed, it would be such a tragedy!

after-completion-of-tale-of-the-righteou.npc: Good thanks. Now that we've found this cave, we're learning more about the lizardmen than ever before.
